trust_decision.summary: Wings decides how much of a server-owned (untrusted) config file it will buffer in daemon memory before rewriting it; at the pinned commit there is no bound in ConfigurationFile.Parse or any per-format parser.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'parsed config files' cause OOM; ConfigurationFile.Parse is the single dispatcher to every format parser.

fix_sites.entry_point: server start (power action) -> Server.UpdateConfigurationFiles (server/power.go:205) -> ConfigurationFile.Parse; size Stat cap added (fix.diff:27-31)
same, Parser=file -> parseTextFile (bufio.Scanner accumulating into bytes.Buffer)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver capping only the format the report names (e.g. json io.ReadAll) could argue the text parser is already bounded by maxTextScanTokenSize (parser/parser.go:480), though that bounds a line, not the accumulated buffer at parser/parser.go:478-497.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Oversized file must be left untouched (not truncated/rewritten) and the server must still boot; a fix that errors out of the start sequence or truncates the file before reading breaks this. Normal-sized configs of every format must still be rewritten.

O6_input_shapes: file larger than cap at Stat time
file growing past Stat size (LimitReader backstop)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a reader of another server-owned control file (like .pteroignore) without the size cap
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the .pteroignore reader already applies a 32 KiB Stat cap (server/backup.go:46), so a sibling helper reading a different server-root file with plain io.ReadAll is a plausible maintainer omission

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new IterateOverJson-style helper that re-reads the file from disk instead of taking the bounded bytes
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: helpers operate on []byte produced by the parse functions; a helper that reopens the file would bypass the per-parser LimitReader

O9_family: uncontrolled memory allocation / resource exhaustion (CWE-400/770/789) from untrusted file size

O10_build.project_tests: none for the parser package (only parser/parser.go and parser/helpers.go exist); ConfigurationFile.Parse takes a ufs.File so it is unit-testable without Docker

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add one Stat size check at the top of ConfigurationFile.Parse (which alone covers all six formats for static files).

out_of_scope_notes: yaml.Unmarshal / etree / ini parse amplification (alias expansion, deep nesting) within a sub-64MB file is not bounded by the fix (parser/parser.go:435).
Docker install/console output scanners (server/install.go:294, environment/docker/container.go:332) are a different sink and not server-owned config files.
unverified: Exact HTTP/websocket routes that trigger HandlePowerAction start were not traced; entry point cited at server/power.go:205 only.
